implementation: let t0 := Int.ediv ((v0 - v1) * 10000) (v2 + 10000); max 0 (min v3 t0)
proof:
by
  intro v0 v1 v2 v3 h
  simp only [pre, pre0, post, post0] at *
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, ⟨h2, h3⟩, h4⟩ := h
  have hk : (0:Int) < v2 + 10000 := by omega
  have e1 := Int.mul_ediv_self_le (x := (v0 - v1) * 10000) (k := v2 + 10000) (by omega)
  have e2 := Int.lt_mul_ediv_self_add (x := (v0 - v1) * 10000) hk
  have hI : implementation v0 v1 v2 v3 = max 0 (min v3 ((v0 - v1) * 10000 / (v2 + 10000))) := rfl
  generalize implementation v0 v1 v2 v3 = r at *
  generalize (v0 - v1) * 10000 / (v2 + 10000) = q at *
  by_cases hq0 : q ≤ 0
  · have m := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq0 (Int.le_of_lt hk)
    have hr : r = 0 := by rw [hI, Int.min_def, Int.max_def]; split <;> (try split) <;> omega
    subst hr
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by omega, ?_⟩
    split
    · omega
    · split
      · grind
      · trivial
  · by_cases hqv : q ≤ v3
    · have hr : r = q := by rw [hI, Int.min_def, Int.max_def]; split <;> (try split) <;> omega
      subst hr
      have hn := Int.mul_nonneg (show (0:Int) ≤ r by omega) h2
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · grind
      · split
        · refine ⟨by grind, ?_⟩
          split
          · grind
          · trivial
        · omega
    · have m := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show v3 ≤ q by omega) (Int.le_of_lt hk)
      have hr : r = v3 := by rw [hI, Int.min_def, Int.max_def]; split <;> (try split) <;> omega
      subst hr
      have hn := Int.mul_nonneg h4 h2
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · grind
      · split
        · refine ⟨by grind, ?_⟩
          split
          · omega
          · trivial
        · split
          · omega
          · trivial
